list: Official 55 trophies — names, descriptions and grades as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles (2026-11-18), cross-checked against PowerPyx, Push Square and TrueTrophies. Guides are original, written for this entry, and cite their sources beside each trophy.

trophies.guide: The platinum pops the moment the 54th other trophy unlocks. There is no online trophy and no DLC requirement, so one single-player playthrough can take you all the way — PowerPyx rates the set 4/10 and roughly 200 hours. Work the roadmap in order: story first, then contacts and strangers, activities, collectibles, combat, and finally the money and mystery trophies plus 100% completion.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
steps: Earn the other 54 trophies.
No multiplayer or DLC is needed — every trophy is single-player.

trophies.guide: Story trophy for the opening mission, Gone Fishing. It unlocks naturally as you play — you cannot miss it, and it is the first story trophy of the game. If you are trophy hunting, just enjoy the introduction; the roadmap starts here.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
steps: Play the opening mission, Gone Fishing.
Finish it to unlock this trophy.

trophies.guide: Story trophy for finishing Chapter 1. Unmissable — it comes with normal story progress. While you play Chapter 1, start the habits that protect the whole run: meditate at any spot you pass (see Positive Mental Attitude) and keep a separate save at the start of the chapter, because the game has no mission replay (PowerPyx).
trophies.name: Paradise Lost
steps: Play through every mission in Chapter 1.
The trophy unlocks when the chapter ends.

trophies.guide: Story trophy for finishing Chapter 2. Unmissable with normal play. Keep the chapter-start save habit going — with no mission replay, a fresh save at each chapter boundary is your only way back if you ever need to redo a story beat (PowerPyx).
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
steps: Play through every mission in Chapter 2.
The trophy unlocks when the chapter ends.

trophies.guide: Story trophy for finishing Chapter 3. Unmissable. By now the map is opening up — if you spot a meditation spot, a WAiNK scan point or a stunt jump while travelling between missions, grab it; the collectible and activity trophies are all doable after the story, but picking them up as you go saves backtracking.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
steps: Play through every mission in Chapter 3.
The trophy unlocks when the chapter ends.

trophies.guide: Story trophy for finishing Chapter 4, the last numbered chapter. Unmissable. After this, only the final mission stands between you and the gold story trophy — and the whole of Leonida opens up for free-roam cleanup.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
steps: Play through every mission in Chapter 4.
The trophy unlocks when the chapter ends.

trophies.guide: Gold story trophy for completing the final mission. Unmissable — finish the story and it is yours. Once it pops, the 100% completion checklist opens under Progress > Stats, and free roam begins in earnest: that is when the long cleanup stages (activities, collectibles, combat) start (PowerPyx, gamemapa).
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
steps: Finish the story's final mission.
The trophy unlocks with the credits.

trophies.guide: Story trophy for the mission Breakfast Run. It unlocks by playing the story — no special requirement, no missable step. Mission trophies like this one are why the roadmap says: play the story first, and let these twelve trophies come to you.
trophies.name: Trust
steps: Play the mission Breakfast Run.
Finish it to unlock this trophy.

trophies.guide: Story trophy for the mission The Cartel Heist. Unmissable with story progress. Heist missions are also good practice for the combat and robbery trophies later — Combat Focus and the getaway driving you learn here come back in Maximum Withdrawal and A Classic Blitz Play.
trophies.name: Break the Bank
steps: Play the mission The Cartel Heist.
Finish it to unlock this trophy.

trophies.guide: Story trophy for the mission Child's Play. Unmissable. Nothing to prepare — just play the mission when the story brings it to you.
trophies.name: Family Matters
steps: Play the mission Child's Play.
Finish it to unlock this trophy.

trophies.guide: Story trophy for the mission Headliners. Unmissable with story progress. Keep moving through the story — the contact and stranger side content unlocks alongside it.
trophies.name: DWNFALL
steps: Play the mission Headliners.
Finish it to unlock this trophy.

trophies.guide: Story trophy for the mission VCIA Takedown. Unmissable. Note the location — Vice City International Airport — because one of the combat trophies, Catch Me If You Can, also happens at VCIA, so you will already know the layout when you go back for it.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
steps: Play the mission VCIA Takedown.
Finish it to unlock this trophy.

trophies.guide: Story trophy for the mission Operation Savage Glory. Unmissable. It is the last of the twelve story trophies — with it, the whole story set is done and the roadmap moves to contacts, strangers and the open-world stages.
trophies.name: Snow Storm
steps: Play the mission Operation Savage Glory.
Finish it to unlock this trophy.

trophies.guide: Gold for reaching 100% completion — the hardest trophy in the set, and the one that decides the platinum. The checklist opens after the story (Progress > Stats). It is stricter than the individual trophies: PowerPyx notes it wants 300 stunts while Cunning Stunts only needs 250, and it folds in more of the same activities, so treat it as the final sweep. Do it last, after every other stage, and use this tracker's checklist to see what is left.
trophies.name: A Long Road
steps: Finish the story to open the 100% checklist under Progress > Stats.
Clear every checklist item — missions, activities, collectibles and stunts.
Note the checklist asks for more than some trophies: 300 stunts where Cunning Stunts asks for 250.

trophies.guide: Silver for completing 250 stunts. PowerPyx counts 397 stunts across Leonida — stunt jumps, under-bridge flights, knife flights and base jumps — so you do not need them all. Chain them into normal travel: pick a fast bike or plane, and route between missions past stunt markers. Remember 100% completion wants 300, so the extra 50 you do now are not wasted.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
steps: Do stunt jumps, flights under bridges, knife flights and base jumps anywhere in Leonida.
Any 250 of the 397 stunts count.
Keep going to 300 if you are aiming at 100% completion.

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Bronze for sampling all nine activity types once. You only need to try each one, not master it — a single attempt counts. Do this early in the activities stage: it doubles as a tour of everything else on the list (races, fishing, arcade, shooting range, drone races), so you will know where to go back for the deeper trophies.
trophies.name: Master of None
steps: Try each of the nine activity types once.
One attempt each is enough — you do not need to win or finish them.

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Silver for gold medals in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. This is a skill trophy, not a grind: learn each range's pattern, use the right weapon for the range, and replay challenges freely — nothing here is missable. Take it slowly, one range at a time, and it is one of the more satisfying silvers on the list.
trophies.name: The Shootist
steps: Visit every Shooting Range in Leonida.
Earn a gold medal in all 42 challenges.
Replay any challenge you miss until it turns gold.

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Bronze for winning a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations. Drone racing is about clean lines, not speed alone — cut corners where the course allows and avoid crashing, since a crash costs more time than a cautious turn. Work through the locations region by region so none gets forgotten.
trophies.name: Top Fun
steps: Find all 14 Top Fun drone race locations.
Win the race at each one.

trophies.guide: Bronze for winning 20 different races. Variety is the requirement: the same race won twice still counts once, so keep moving to new events. Use the best vehicle class for each race type, and remember the winnings feed the money trophies (Dime on the Dollar, Treat Yo Self) at the same time.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
steps: Enter races around Leonida.
Win 20 different ones — repeats of the same race do not count twice.

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Bronze for beating Cal in a fishing challenge. Fishing challenges are timing challenges — watch the line tension and the fish's runs, and do not rush the reel. Find Cal at the fishing spots, take the challenge, and beat his catch. It also counts toward your activity sampling for Master of None.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
steps: Find Cal at a fishing challenge spot.
Take the challenge and beat his catch.

trophies.guide: Bronze for completing one arcade game. Pick the arcade game you find easiest — you only need to finish one. Arcades are scattered around Vice City and the wider state; finishing a game also samples another activity type for Master of None.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
steps: Find an arcade in Leonida.
Complete one arcade game, any title.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Bronze for completing Andy's final mission. Andy is one of five contacts with a mission chain ending in a trophy (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone). Play through Andy's missions as they come; the finale unlocks this trophy. None of the contact chains is missable — they stay available after the story.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
steps: Take Andy's missions as they appear.
Complete Andy's final mission.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Bronze for completing Kenton's final mission. Like the other contact finales, this is a story-adjacent chain you play through in order — no special requirement, just finish the last mission Kenton gives you.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
steps: Take Kenton's missions as they appear.
Complete Kenton's final mission.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Bronze for completing Billy's final mission. Work through Billy's chain alongside the other contacts in stage 2 of the roadmap. The mission names and order come from the story, so there is nothing to look up — just keep taking Billy's calls.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider
steps: Take Billy's missions as they appear.
Complete Billy's final mission.

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Silver for completing 8 stranger mission strands. Strangers and Freaks-style side questlines are scattered across Leonida — talk to the marked strangers and follow each strand to its end. PowerPyx notes only some side questlines count toward the eight, and is still confirming exactly which, so finish more than eight strands to be safe, and do them after the story when the map is fully open.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
steps: Find stranger missions across Leonida.
Complete 8 full strands — finish more than 8 to be safe, since only some questlines count.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Bronze for completing Randy's final mission. The fourth of the five contact finales. Play Randy's chain in order; the finale pops the trophy. Pair this stage with the stranger strands — both are open-world side content that fills the gap between story and cleanup.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand
steps: Take Randy's missions as they appear.
Complete Randy's final mission.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Bronze for completing Tyrone's final mission — the last of the five contact finales. Once Tyrone's chain is done, stage 2 of the roadmap is nearly complete; only the stranger strands and Bret's hunt remain before the activities stage.
trophies.name: Spin On This!
steps: Take Tyrone's missions as they appear.
Complete Tyrone's final mission.

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Bronze for meditating at all 18 spots across Leonida — and the one trophy in the whole set that may be missable. PowerPyx and GTABase both flag it as possibly missable, while Push Square reports none known, so play it safe: meditate at every spot you pass from the very start of the game, and keep a separate save at the beginning of each chapter (there is no mission replay). If you reach the end with spots left, sweep them in free roam — the spots themselves stay available, so the risk is only if a spot is tied to a chapter you have finished.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.sources: Exophase · PSNProfiles · PowerPyx · GTABase · Push Square
steps: Meditate at every spot you find — 18 in total.
Do spots as you pass them from Chapter 1 onward.
Keep a chapter-start save, since there is no mission replay.

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Bronze for hunting a unique animal for Bret. Bret's hunt is a tracking task: follow the clues to the animal's territory, track it quietly, and take the shot cleanly. It sits in stage 2 with the contact chains — a single self-contained hunt, not a grind.
trophies.name: Fair Game
steps: Take Bret's hunt.
Track the unique animal and bring it down.

trophies.guide: Silver for completing 3 collectible card sets — there are 18 sets in total, so you only need three. Cards are hidden across Leonida; collect them as you explore and the sets will complete naturally. This is a good companion trophy for the WAiNK and exploration sweeps in stage 4.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
steps: Collect cards found across Leonida.
Complete any 3 of the 18 sets.

trophies.guide: Silver for WAiNK-scanning 100 locations — landmarks, curiosities and sculptures across the state. The WAiNK app is your scanner: point it at anything notable and it logs the spot. Fold this into the exploration sweep: every area you visit for The Goodtime State and every vehicle you log for Whip It Good is a chance to scan. A WAiNK scan also counts as discovering a vehicle, so these two trophies feed each other.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
steps: Open the WAiNK app and scan landmarks, curiosities and sculptures.
Reach 100 scanned locations.

trophies.guide: Bronze for completing 50 of the 80 challenges. Challenges are the small goals layered over everything else — driving, combat, exploration, activities — so they complete in the background of the other stages. Check the challenge list regularly and steer toward the ones closest to done; the last few will need deliberate effort after everything else is finished.
trophies.name: One Last Thing
steps: Open the challenge list and work through it.
Complete any 50 of the 80 challenges.

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Bronze for losing a 4-star wanted level while playing with your partner, then escaping. Build the wanted level deliberately — cause enough trouble to reach four stars — then break line of sight, switch vehicles, and use the map's hiding spots until the stars clear. Doing it with your partner alongside is the requirement, so trigger it during a partner free-roam session.
trophies.name: Hot Together
steps: Play with your partner in free roam.
Reach a 4-star wanted level, then lose it and escape.

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Bronze for robbing 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your wanted level. Plan the route first: three shops close together, a fast getaway car parked nearby, and no police between them. Rob, move, rob — and keep the wanted level alive the whole way. If the level drops, start the chain over.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy
steps: Pick three shops close together and park a fast car nearby.
Rob all three in a row with your partner, keeping your wanted level.

trophies.guide: Bronze for discovering 100 vehicles. A WAiNK scan is enough to log a vehicle, so this pairs perfectly with You WAiNKer! — scan every new vehicle you see and both counters climb together. Variety helps: traffic, parked cars, boats and aircraft all count as discoveries.
trophies.name: Whip It Good
steps: Scan new vehicles with WAiNK as you find them.
Discover 100 vehicles in total.

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Bronze for taking down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Set it up: gather a group of enemies in one place — a gang hideout or a wanted-level chase — trigger Combat Focus, and chain the takedowns before the meter runs out. Use cover between targets and pick clustered enemies so no time is wasted moving.
trophies.name: Gunslinger
steps: Find a cluster of enemies.
Trigger Combat Focus and take down 5 before it ends.

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Bronze for making an unscheduled departure at Vice City International Airport. You already know VCIA from the story mission VCIA Takedown — go back, grab a plane, and take off without filing a flight plan. Expect airport security to object; a fast plane and a low departure are the way out.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
steps: Go to VCIA.
Take a plane and depart without a schedule — expect resistance.

trophies.guide: Bronze for dealing with Rhinos — the tanks. This one is about the encounter, not a checklist: find a situation with Rhino tanks and handle it. Bring heavy weapons and use the terrain; a tank's cannon is slow to turn, so flanking beats a head-on fight.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank
steps: Find a Rhino tank encounter.
Deal with the tanks — flank, do not trade shots head-on.

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Bronze for robbing a jewelry store without being detected. Stealth is the whole trophy: case the store first, move quietly, take the goods and leave before anyone raises the alarm. If you are spotted, leave and try again — detection voids the attempt, not the trophy.
trophies.name: Sneakthief
steps: Case a jewelry store.
Rob it without being detected — if spotted, leave and retry.

trophies.guide: Silver for robbing 5 bank vaults and escaping each time. Vaults are the big heists of the open world: plan the entry, crack the vault, and — the part that counts — escape cleanly afterwards. A fast car staged nearby and a route that breaks line of sight are worth more than firepower. Do all five; each escape counts separately.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
steps: Find a bank vault and rob it.
Escape cleanly — the escape is what counts.
Repeat for 5 vaults.

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Bronze for robbing an armored truck and escaping. Armored trucks run set routes around Leonida — intercept one, stop it, take the cash and break away before backup arrives. The classic blitz play: hit it fast, then vanish into traffic.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
steps: Intercept an armored truck on its route.
Rob it and escape before backup arrives.

trophies.guide: Bronze for exploring all 52 areas of Leonida. The map tracks your coverage, so this is a completionist's road trip: drive, fly and sail into every corner of the state, from the Vice City streets to the swamps and keys. Fold it into the other sweeps — WAiNK scans, vehicles, meditation spots and cards are all found while you explore.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State
steps: Travel through all 52 areas of Leonida.
Use the map to find areas you have not visited yet.

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Bronze for robbing an illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. Every gang runs operations somewhere in Leonida — find one per gang, hit it, and get out. This is a tour of the state's underworld: nine gangs, nine operations, nine clean getaways.
trophies.name: Pest Control
steps: Find an illegal operation for each of the 9 gangs.
Rob one operation per gang.

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Bronze for enjoying a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. A quiet moment trophy — head to Ocean Beach, order a cocktail, and take in the view. PowerPyx lists this one's exact trigger as still unconfirmed, so treat it as a hidden trophy to try in free roam: visit the beach bars at sunset and look for the prompt. It is one of five hidden trophies whose conditions the guide community has not yet pinned down.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…
steps: Go to Ocean Beach in free roam.
Look for a cocktail spot with a view and take the moment in.

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Bronze for smashing your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style — a nod to the series' most famous entrance. Like the other hidden side trophies, PowerPyx lists its exact trigger as unconfirmed: try it in a showroom in free roam, in a suitable vehicle, and look for the moment the game recognises. It is a style trophy, not a grind.
trophies.name: Capital Offense
steps: Find a vehicle showroom.
Smash your way out of it in classic style.

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Bronze for follow-through at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley. Head to the alley, play a frame, and follow through on the shot — the trophy is about the bowling itself, a callback to the series' past. One of the hidden side trophies; the alley is the place to be.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
steps: Go to the Kolt & Associates bowling alley.
Bowl a frame with a proper follow-through.

trophies.guide: Bronze for a partnership moment with mass appeal. The description is deliberately vague — it is one of the hidden side trophies, and its exact trigger is not yet confirmed by the guide community. It reads as a partner-activity trophy: spend time with your partner in free roam, do the shared activities, and watch for the moment the game flags it. Check back with PowerPyx and Push Square as their guides fill in.
trophies.name: Personal Best
steps: Spend time with your partner in free roam.
Do shared partner activities until the moment triggers.

trophies.guide: Bronze for choices made, for better or worse. PSNProfiles tracks a count toward this one (500), so it is a cumulative trophy: keep making story and side choices as you play and the counter climbs. There is nothing to force — play the game, make the calls, and it will come.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
steps: Make choices as you play — story and side decisions both count.
Keep going until the tracked count (500) is reached.

trophies.guide: Bronze for second time's the charm — succeed on a second attempt. The exact trigger is not yet confirmed by the guide community (PowerPyx lists it as unconfirmed), so the working reading is: fail something, then succeed on the retry. It is one of the five hidden trophies to try naturally during play and check against updated guides.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
steps: Attempt something and fail it once.
Succeed on the second attempt.

trophies.guide: Bronze for witnessing something strange. This is the game's weird-moment trophy — one of five hidden trophies whose conditions PowerPyx lists as still unknown. Expect an easter egg or a random event somewhere in Leonida; explore odd corners, follow strange prompts, and keep an eye on the guide community as players report what triggered it for them.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
steps: Explore Leonida's odd corners and random events.
Witness the strange moment when it happens.

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bronze for knocking someone down with a melee drive-by. The method is still being confirmed by the guide community (keengamer notes the precise method is unconfirmed): the working reading is a drive-by performed with a melee weapon from a moving vehicle. Try it in free roam with a slow vehicle and a clear target, and check PowerPyx for the confirmed method as guides update.
trophies.name: Ten Pin
steps: Get a melee weapon and a vehicle.
Perform a melee drive-by and knock the target down.

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Bronze for laundering a cumulative $250,000 in Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from heists and robberies, and contacts wash them into clean money — the total is cumulative, so every job feeds it. By the time you finish the combat and heist stage you will be well on the way; keep laundering after each score and the counter will clear $250,000 on its own.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
steps: Earn Marked Bills from heists and robberies.
Launder them through your contacts until $250,000 is washed.

trophies.guide: Bronze for spending a total of $100,000 across shops. The total is cumulative across every shop in Leonida — weapons, clothes, cars, food. You will spend much of it naturally on gear for the other trophies; if you are short at the end, buy and sell high-value items to push the total over the line.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
steps: Spend money in shops across Leonida — weapons, clothes, vehicles.
Reach $100,000 spent in total.

trophies.guide: Bronze for purchasing all 8 garage properties. Garages are the practical collectible: they store the vehicles you discover for Whip It Good and On the Spot. Buy them as you earn money — the laundering and robbery income from the other stages pays for them — and the last purchase pops the trophy.
trophies.name: Little Boxes
steps: Earn money from jobs, races and robberies.
Buy all 8 garage properties.

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Bronze for registering 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Open the app, register the vehicles you have discovered — any ten count. It pairs with Whip It Good (discover 100 vehicles) and Little Boxes (garages to keep them in): discover, register, store.
trophies.name: On the Spot
steps: Open the Scooter Bros app.
Register 10 vehicles you have discovered.
